name: grooming
description: Washing, trimming and nail care for pets, at a salon or at home.

species.description: The animals taken, such as dog or cat.

homeVisits.description: True when the seller comes to the buyer's place.

howDealsGo: The owner pays into escrow at booking and releases after the appointment, or pays and releases in one tap at pickup. Done is the pet groomed as agreed and unhurt. A timer to the seller, set past the appointment, pays for work done if the owner goes quiet. Before paying, mention any health problems or nerves.
